item.title: Bomb blast near Colombia’s border with Venezuela injures at least 4 police officers
item.description: An attack with explosives near a bridge on Colombia's border with Venezuela injured at least four police officers in Cucuta.

item.title: US military says 5 were killed by a strike on an alleged drug boat in the eastern Pacific
item.description: The U.S. military says it has attacked a boat it accused of smuggling drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean. Tuesday's attack killed five people.

item.title: Supreme Court won't intervene to allow judges to pause some deportation proceedings
item.description: The Supreme Court has declined to intervene in a dispute over a Biden-era immigration regulation. Democratic-led cities sought to revive the rule, which allowed immigration judges to pause some deportation proceedings.

item.title: Panel finds that 37 suspected illegal miners suffocated in overcrowded cell in Nigeria
item.description: A Nigerian government investigation panel has found that 37 suspected illegal miners suffocated in an overcrowded cell last month.
